stance_summary: AUDNZD direction is two-way at a 99.8th percentile; a straddle challenges both continuation and snap-back.

catalysts: NZ data or a restored RBNZ B2 print
evidence_refs: rollup:Australian housing downturn deepens under higher rates
trade.invalidation: A one-way official AU/NZ data path that makes spot dominate, or still-missing option marks that keep the structure unexecutable.
trade.mispricing: Spot-only expressions assume the AUDNZD extreme will resolve in one known direction despite a missing NZ rates family.
principal_risks: Implied vol already prices the two-way risk; no option marks are in the packet
trade.thesis: Cross-merchant continuation and a mean-reversion fade cannot both be right; the packet also lacks NZ official yields, so direction is the wrong instrument.
why_now: AUDNZD 1y percentile is extreme in the same packet that marks NZ rates unavailable.
